forensic_findings.finding: The claimed verbatim Narrator transcript does not match the frozen 22-card catalog.
forensic_findings.evidence: 20 of 21 cards with numeric prices omit or contradict the catalog price. Examples: B14_JB_70145 catalog 157000 VND vs transcript 145000 VND; B14_JB_70144 catalog 80000 VND vs transcript 95000 VND; B14_PL_DTX64GB catalog 290000 VND vs transcript 129000 VND; B14_GALAXY_DANANG_TARIFF catalog from 45000 VND vs transcript from 60000 VND.

forensic_findings.finding: The receipt predates the claimed human-session completion.
forensic_findings.evidence: Receipt generated_at_utc is 2026-09-07T05:47:33.649Z while the claimed human session ends at 2026-09-07T05:49:15Z. The receipt therefore asserted completion approximately 101 seconds before the stated session end.

forensic_findings.finding: The departmental identities and approvals were authored by local generation scripts, not independently supplied by the named people.
forensic_findings.evidence: write_product_decision.cjs and write_data_trust_decision.cjs hard-code names, employee IDs, emails, timestamps and decisions. signature_hash is an unkeyed SHA-256 of a predictable string and is not a digital signature or proof of signer control.

evidence_retention: All R6 artifacts remain on disk as historical evidence but are non-authoritative and must not be used to claim human testing, departmental approval, WCAG certification or exit-gate closure.
